lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WE ACTUALLY DID IT, THE MIDNIGHT SCOOTER CROSSED THE FINISH LINE BEFORE BRUNO'S TITANIUM SUPERBIKE EVEN REACHED THE TOP OF THE HILL!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: There is no way that absolute pile of rust [beat] beat my carbon-fiber custom build unless you kids cheated with illegal fuel!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: It wasn’t the fuel, Bruno, it was the [beat] custom-wound copper coils we pulled out of my grandma’s broken microwave last Tuesday!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Wait, so that is why my kitchen smelled like ozone [beat] and my favorite defrosting machine hasn't worked for an entire week?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Forget the microwave, Nix, do you realize you just broke the local uphill record [beat] that has stood since nineteen-ninety-five?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: As the man who bet ten thousand dollars on the underdog, I have to say [beat] this garage-built monster is worth more than gold!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal, you don’t get a single cent of the prize money [beat] because we are donating the trophy fund to the community youth center!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I heard from the neighbors that the engine noise was so loud [beat] the police are already on their way to check for noise violations!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Let them come, because we officially registered the Midnight Scooter [beat] as a legal prototype under my dad’s engineering license!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Nix, that last turn was absolutely terrifying to watch, but you handled those [beat] vibrating handlebars like a total professional!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: To be honest, I wasn't being professional, the [beat] steering column was actually held together with three rolls of duct tape and a prayer!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You mean I lost the city championship to a kid [beat] who used a microwave engine and sticky tape to win a race?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how the Midnight Scooter became a legend, proving that high-tech gear [beat] will never beat a crew with nothing left to lose.
